tasks.label: Keil: Build WHEELTEC
args: & 'D:\Keil_v5\UV4\UV4.exe' -b '${workspaceFolder}\R550_C30D(2.0)_Mini小车STM32源码_GMR编码器_2025.12.26\USER\WHEELTEC.uvprojx' -t 'FreeRTOS' -j0; $logPath = '${workspaceFolder}\R550_C30D(2.0)_Mini小车STM32源码_GMR编码器_2025.12.26\OBJ\WHEELTEC.build_log.htm'; $hexPath = '${workspaceFolder}\R550_C30D(2.0)_Mini小车STM32源码_GMR编码器_2025.12.26\OBJ\WHEELTEC.hex'; $html = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $logPath; $text = [System.Net.WebUtility]::HtmlDecode(($html -replace '(?i)<br\s*/?>', "`n" -replace '(?i)</(pre|h1|h2|p|tr|div)>', "`n" -replace '<[^>]+>', '')); $text -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match '\): (error|warning):|Error\(s\)|Target not created' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_.Trim() }; if ($text -match '(\d+)\s+Error\(s\)' -and [int]$Matches[1] -eq 0 -and $text -notmatch 'Target not created' -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hexPath)) { Write-Output 'Keil build succeeded.'; exit 0 } else { Write-Output 'Keil build failed.'; exit 1 }
